mapper.select: SELECT MIN(id) AS id, album_id, chapter_id, chapter_name, chapter_add_time, series_id, liked, is_favorite, MIN(image_file) AS image_file, MIN(image_sort) AS image_sort FROM `t_jm_chapter_image` WHERE album_id = #{albumId} GROUP BY album_id, chapter_id, chapter_name, chapter_add_time, series_id, liked, is_favorite ORDER BY CAST(chapter_id AS INTEGER)
